    codex-catalog: https://catalog.example/codex.json # c98
# c99
    devin-catalog: "https://catalog.example/codex.json"
management:
    allow-remote: false
#   c100 with words
    disable-control-panel: true #   c101 with words
    secret-key: '$2y$12$another'
    "panel-github-repository": ' https://github.com/example/panel '
requests:
# c102
    "proxy-url": >-
        mailto:someone@example.com
#c103
'upstream':
    claude: # c105
        header-defaults: # c106
            arch: x64
            stabilize-device-profile: false
"server":
    port: 0
plugins: # c107
    enabled: false # c108
    dir: ferry-plugins
    store-sources:
#   c109 with words
#   c110 with words
        - 'https://store.example/index.json'
    "configs": # c111
        alpha: # c112
# c113
            enabled: true
            settings:

                endpoint: https://hook.example/run #   c115 with words

        beta:
            priority: -5

            text: "clip text\n"
        gamma:
# c120
            enabled: true
#c121
            priority: -5

            settings:
                endpoint: unix:///run/plugin.sock

# c125
            text: >+
                keep several

        max-part-count: 64
        max-revision-bytes: 16777216

        max-details: 10000
        max-string-bytes: 256
        staging-retention: 1m
